moral.zh: 科学家还在研究；目前较强证据显示，条纹会干扰牛虻靠近和降落，减少叮咬，也可能有其他作用。
moral.en: Scientists are still studying zebra stripes; strong evidence shows they can make it harder for biting flies to land.
